config.model: Original separable nonconvex benchmark; amplitude 5, initial 3.6, tau (.15,.15,.25,.30)
config.score: (N-1)/(N*(M-1))*sum_i ||g_i-gbar||^2; empirical EMA, not an upper bound
config.pilot: One uniform M-subset per block at U0; paid B*M calls for both fixed and adaptive
config.pairing: Same data, initial state, independent uniform block quantiles and uniform node subsets; distinct p produce different realized blocks
config.oracle_unit: One exact current client/block empirical gradient (Q components)
config.diagnostics: Full mapping evaluated at every state, separately counted and timed; never feeds training/probabilities
config.first_hit: First observed instantaneous full squared mapping below target; includes pilot, excludes diagnostics; not a certified stopping rule
config.timing: Single-process dense NumPy training only, includes pilot and probability updates; excludes diagnostic path and data generation; not system speed evidence
config.adaptation: Only the selected score changes, after current sampling, for the next draw; zero extra gradient calls
config.communication: Not measured; dense state updates do not instantiate deferred communication
config.tuning: All settings fixed before results; no method-specific tuning or excluded seeds
